findings.title: Zinc deficient (DTPA-Zn 0.45 mg/kg, below 0.6)
findings.evidence: Cereals on zinc-deficient soils show pale, streaked young leaves and poor tillering, and the canopy stays below its potential.
findings.action: Apply zinc sulphate (ZnSO₄·H₂O) at about 25 kg/ha broadcast before sowing, or a 0.5% ZnSO₄ foliar spray at tillering as a faster correction. Confirm the rate with your local agronomist.

findings.title: Wind 27 km/h — too windy to spray
findings.evidence: Spray drift is a real risk above about 15 km/h.
findings.action: Schedule foliar zinc or any spray for a calmer morning.

findings.title: 35.9 mm of rain forecast in the next 7 days
findings.evidence: Soil-applied fertilizer dissolves and moves with heavy rain.
findings.action: Split nitrogen into smaller doses if rain is due, and avoid broadcasting soluble products just before it.

unknowns: Satellite pixels cannot see soil chemistry: micronutrient, nutrient and pH values only come from a soil test.
notes: Advice is rule-based guidance from satellite indices, live weather and any entered lab results. It is not a prescription.
Confirm fertilizer rates against your local soil test and agronomist before applying.
